where: Part 10 #1 §10.1 Immediate — trust, exit and privacy [4.6a, 3.2]
claim: Make account deletion work in one step, in-app and on the web, and confirm it by e-mail: 47 reviews, mean 1.23; 23 in 2020 alone; still reported in 2025
Put an unsubscribe link in every e-mail and honour account deletion across marketing systems: 37 reviews, 27 in July 2023; GDPR and CAN-SPAM cited; failure still reported in May 2024
Audit the in-app help conversation list for cross-customer leakage — a single claim that other customers' messages, e-mails and photos were visible, but one that must be ruled out
Make goal-sharing opt-in and use expiring or unguessable links

where: Part 10 #5 §10.1 [Warning 3, 2.4]

where: Part 10 #6 §10.2 Immediate — entitlement portability [4.3, 6.5]
claim: One entitlement per person, recognised on every platform: web (Paddle) purchases must unlock iOS, iOS purchases must unlock Mac and web, and guest and account purchases merge automatically — about 25 portability cases including 6+ week resolutions
Show the renewal date, price and a cancel link in-app for every billing channel: 13 cancellation traps; 45 refund reviews
Make trial conversion explicit: a reminder before the charge, and access kept after cancelling a renewal
Never show upsell or cross-promotion to payers: 14 + 12 reviews

where: Part 10 #10 §10.3 Near-term — parity, sync and reach [4.4]
claim: Release parity: no feature ships on iOS without Mac, web and Watch support in the same release, or a visible 'coming' state — Mac/web was 18.5% of 2022 reviews and support conceded the gap
Offer iCloud sync as an option alongside the account backend, and a reachable endpoint for mainland China: 173 China reviews; iCloud requested repeatedly
Restore interactive widgets (incremental +1, streak, compact) and fix widget refresh on iPad: widget complaints were 6.3% of 2025
Watch: single-tap completion and area / time-of-day complications back; sync without opening the phone
Health accuracy: de-duplicate sleep, allow manual override of Health-linked habits, and do not wipe data when switching tracking mode

where: Part 10 #15 §10.4 Near-term — stop removing, start migrating [4.5, 6.7]
claim: Every removal gets a toggle or a migration — priorities: notes back-dating and editing, an off switch for the 'day is over?' pop-up, the passcode lock, ordering that sticks
Keep 'simple mode' defaults: hide friends, challenges and journal until enabled — complexity complaints tripled to 5.8% of E5
Replace guilt copy with neutral or positive notifications, and let users choose categories: 43 reviews on unwanted or guilt notifications

Offer monthly in-app in every storefront, and regionalise lifetime pricing (¥19,000; Vietnam and Turkey requests)
Keep the lifetime option and publish what lifetime includes — it is the top purchase trigger
